question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `plugin-sdk/media-base64` and extend the existing media facade contracts to support this WhatsApp refactor?
rationale: These exports become a compatibility-sensitive external Plugin SDK surface; code review can assess implementation quality but cannot decide the intended durable API boundary.

options.title: Approve the focused media SDK contract
options.body: Accept the additive focused facade and documented broad-barrel deprecation, then require a rebase and resolved-head validation before merge.

options.title: Keep the helpers internal
options.body: Narrow the branch so WhatsApp and core share internal media helpers without adding a new public Plugin SDK entrypoint.

recommendation.title: Approve the focused media SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept the additive focused facade and documented broad-barrel deprecation, then require a rebase and resolved-head validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor most directly to the proposed WhatsApp/media API boundary; final API acceptance still requires the repository’s designated SDK owners.
